title: Chapter 299 Buying Time
content:
Chapter 299 Buying Time

He did not give any explanation to Wang Shuo. It was obvious that he wanted Wang Shuo to hold back the Undead Knights and buy him time to escape.

A dead Taoist friend will not die a poor Taoist!

There is no mercy on the battlefield, so I can only apologize this time.

Wang Shuo discovered something unusual about the White Horse Knights and rushed out of the battlefield.

Wang Shuo:?

Wang Shuo:? ? ?

Wang Shuo:......

Wang Shuo:!

Wang Shuo:! ! !

"Damn you, you actually ran away!"

Wang Shuo was so angry that he wanted to scold his mother.

Seeing the tragic situation of the White Horse Knights, although Wang Shuo understood, he still wanted to scold his mother.

The Undead Knights opposite had more than 8,000 people left, and the more than 4,000 of them were not enough to fill the gap between their teeth.

How to top it?

"withdraw."

Wang Shuo also shouted, but Wang Shuo's retreat speed was at least half a minute slower than Su Xiu's.

As a result, Su Xiu almost disappeared, and Wang Shuo began to retreat.

Seeing this situation, Farati did not chase Su Xiu.

The main goal of his trip was Wang Shuo. He wanted to capture Wang Shuo alive in order to please the bloodthirsty demon wolf.

Wang Shuo saw all the undead knights coming to chase him, and he was even more furious. At least you should also divide some of your people to chase Su Xiu, so as to relieve me a little pressure.

Wang Shuo took all his men and quickly retreated to the canyon that had been selected long ago.

The mouth of the valley is narrow and can only accommodate 10 riders at most. At the same time, although the cliffs on both sides are not very high, they are still 40 to 50 meters high.

Wang Shuo had no choice but to keep his two strongest trump cards to cut off the queen.

If all the lords of the Nanshan Society who followed him were wiped out in this battle, I believe that no one would fight with him again.

Wang Shuo quickly created a swamp trap on the outside. Members of the Hell Knights also took out a large number of "rejection horses" from their backpacks to block the pursuers.

These Juma are naturally the masterpieces of the carpentry workshop. After studying the "Artisan's Manual", they successfully produced some practical war instruments, and Juma is one of them.

The backbone of this kind of horse-rejection is a huge log, and the log is covered with a large number of sharp spears. A discerning person will not rush forward directly after seeing it, which naturally achieves the effect of delaying the cavalry charge.

But the Knights of the Undead don't care about this.

The knight at the front rushed directly to the horse and was thrown off the horse. At the same time, he was stabbed by a spear and had several broken ribs.

But even so, it cannot stop the undead behind from advancing.

Even if it was a swamp, they rushed straight into it.

Wang Shuo's heart felt like ten thousand undead war horses rushing past, and he just wanted to curse.

When the cooling time was over, Wang Shuo quickly made another swamp trap next to it, and at the same time ordered all the three-headed hell dogs to line up in a tight formation, spitting fire and poison at the outside.

At the same time, he constantly exhales healing energy to delay time.

Now I can only trade my life for time.

One good thing about the Cerberus is that it can hide in the breeding space when it is about to lose its strength.

Their own recovery ability is still very strong.

As long as he doesn't die and rests for a while, he will be able to be full of energy again.

When the attack was blocked, Ferrati cursed: "Trash."

The surrounding undead knights dispersed to make way for a passage.

Ferrati charged directly, stepping on the corpse of the undead knight in the swamp, and rushed to the three-headed dog.

The spear swept across, directly knocking back the eight three-headed hell dogs that were resisting, and even the knights on them were swept to the ground.

Wang Shuo saw that the situation was wrong and stepped forward.

Gong Zheng just acted like a "big ass" and sat on it.

His "Taishan Overwhelming" move not only stunned Ferrati for 0.5 seconds, but more importantly, knocked him off his horse.

Ayub and Gude quickly followed suit and joined the battle group.

A siege against the boss began.
